details: Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari indicated that a significant price shock could necessitate a series of interest rate hikes from the Federal Reserve, moving away from previous expectations of rate cuts. This hawkish stance, influenced by factors like persistent inflation and geopolitical tensions impacting energy prices, introduces uncertainty and could negatively affect risk assets, including cryptocurrencies.
title: Fed's Kashkari Warns: Price Shock Could Force Aggressive Rate Hikes

details: Escalating US-Iran conflict, including the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, has led to a significant surge in oil prices and increased global market volatility. This geopolitical risk has fostered a "risk-off" sentiment, resulting in over $560 million in cryptocurrency liquidations and impacting Bitcoin and Ethereum prices.
title: Geopolitical Tensions Cause $560M Crypto Liquidations

details: Coinbase Global Inc. has announced a breakthrough agreement on stablecoin yield provisions, potentially ending a legislative stalemate in the U.S. Senate. This compromise addresses the contentious "rewards" feature, allowing platforms to offer incentives with stricter limitations, which is expected to advance broader digital asset market structure legislation.
title: Coinbase Compromise Paves Way for US Stablecoin Bill

details: Data indicates that Bitcoin's 90-day correlation coefficient with the S&P 500 has risen to 0.60, nearing 2023 levels. This signals that Bitcoin is increasingly behaving like a traditional risk asset rather than a distinct alternative, influenced by macroeconomic conditions, interest rates, and institutional participation.
title: Bitcoin-US Stock Correlation Surges to 2023 Levels

details: Recent central bank decisions, including from the Federal Reserve and European Central Bank, indicate a prolonged period of elevated interest rates. This "higher-for-longer" policy stance keeps borrowing costs high and reduces market liquidity, making traditional assets like bonds more attractive and limiting capital flows into riskier assets such as cryptocurrencies.
title: Central Banks Sustain High Rates, Dampening Crypto Demand
